corrected_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    if user.interviewer?
      can :read, JobApplication
      cannot :read, JobApplication, [:expected_salary, :background_check_notes]
    end
  end
end

class Hiring::ApplicationsController < ApplicationController
  def show
    @application = JobApplication.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :read, @application
    render json: @application.as_json(except: [:expected_salary, :background_check_notes])
  end
end
